$comment: Font manifest. User fonts win: BW_FONT_DIR (env, or fontDir in the gitignored .local/config.json), then the per-user Windows font folder. Under BW_FONT_DIR each family folder holds otf/, woff2/ and a local ttf/ made with otf-to-ttf.py; ttf/ is searched first because Chrome prints CFF outlines (.otf/.woff2) as Type 3. The LAST fallback is fonts/nj-fonts: the owner's licensed Thmanyah copy bundled in the repo (Thmanyah licence, not MIT). ${BW_ROOT} is the repo or plugin root; other ${VAR} expand from the environment.

Thmanyah Serif Display.use: cover title, headings, chapter chips, spine code

Thmanyah Sans.use: editor interface only; not used in documents

weightUse.300: only where a design already uses a light weight

uploadSlot: fonts/custom/ (gitignored; only its README is tracked)
